company.name: Trela
company.shortDescription: Your one-stop shop to eat well in Brazil
company.description:
Trela is the consumer app with the highest NPS in Brazil and the grocer with the highest NPS worldwide.

Our mission is to help people eat better. We are curating the highest-quality food and beverage products in Brazil and implementing a just-in-time supply chain that maximizes freshness and minimizes waste of everything we sell. At Trela, you will find a one-stop shop for healthy groceries in São Paulo, all delivered to your doorstep at the most competitive prices.

We are fortunate to work with some of the leading technology investors in Latin America and the world, including SoftBank, Kaszek, General Catalyst and Y Combinator.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $25,000,000, or 89.93% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $23,134,806 to $122,038,945, a 5.28x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 61 (+0 over 90 days) and market heat at 57 (-6).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Zé Delivery, Rappi Brasil, iFood.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
